tools.name: get_business_facts
tools.description: The published facts about 905 Trades: what it does, the phone number, opening hours, the towns it serves, its services, and how it handles pricing. Every fact here also appears on the public website. Call this first.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search over the pages of the 905 Trades website. Returns page ids, titles and canonical URLs. Use fetch with an id to read a page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one page of the 905 Trades website, as Markdown, with its canonical URL for citation. The id comes from search.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a homeowner's request to 905 Trades so one contractor for that trade and town calls them back. This sends a REAL message to a real small business, so call it only when the person has clearly asked to be contacted by 905 Trades and has given you their own name and their own phone number or email

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "request_quote" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Send a homeowner's request to 905 Trades so one contractor for that trade and town calls them back. This sends a REAL message to a real small business, so call …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
